echidna.scope: single-actor purchase-only; at most64 successful buys per state

proof_limits: Critical remains native dissent, conditional RF-001 High controlling classification; uncapped sales alone do not prove unconditional Critical.

RF-002 now explicitly includes existing cross-factory clone ticket loss, separate from future same-factory sponsor-prize return. CONFIG-001 applies to future treasury collision, not automatically the cross-factory case.
OBS-004 retains actual-call receiver capability observation. Do not attach DAYBREAK-F-03 to OBS-004 merely because it also involves a recipient; correction receipt removes that edge.
OOS-01 and UL-05 are EVIDENCE-001 external boundaries, not in-scope frontend vulnerabilities.

Foundry invariants target only S6PurchaseHandler.buy: one actor, one raffle, entries1..1000, active sales. Echidna has the same purchase-only domain and64-success cap/no-op afterward. Zero reverts does not mean terminal exits or multi-actor authorization were explored.
21 unit/fuzz tests include separate lifecycle/adversarial examples; two10000-case fuzz properties do not turn the active-only invariant campaign into terminal proof. No formal verification.

Native source-first SEAL changed between watcher observations; old seal bytes unavailable. Native final wording immutable seal is qualified by that retained gap; first-pass report bytes stayed identical.
Safe-transfer acceptance does not guarantee future bearer capability; suggested recovery/rotation changes require ownership and liability policy. No patch or owner risk acceptance.

malicious_prize.result: Executed fake custody and fake delivery with sponsor/protocol payout; actualOwner remains sponsor. Conditional adversarial mock, not a deployed-collection claim.

contract_receiver.result: TicketOnlyReceiver actually calls redeem() at line328; no impossible contract impersonation. It accepts only ticket callbacks, has no NFT transfer-out function, and receives the prize via unsafe transfer. Sponsor or buyer must select the incapable owner.

cross_factory.result: Owner selects an existing other-factory clone as unsafe ticket destination. Local registry omits it. Ticket reaches clone with no general execution method. Distinct executed RF-002 variant requiring no future nonce; self-selected asset loss, not theft.
